headline: On last trading day, Sensex gained 300 points, recovering from a sharp crash despite a seventh straight weekly decline.

summary: The Indian market recovered slightly in the last session with the Sensex gaining 300 points, though it remains pressured by a seventh consecutive weekly loss. Significant drags came from a 14% profit decline at TCS and losses in major stocks like Infosys and Bharti Airtel. Investors are also monitoring a dip in national forex reserves and rising FDI inflows.
